blocker.finding: Approved raw retrieval evidence cannot separate related but absent attributes from semantic answers in the pinned hybrid fit cohort.
unblock_choices: predeclare and review a new raw retrieval feature and a new E6 version
explicitly amend the contract to permit a reader or cross-encoder

candidate_membership_rule.fts: coverage contributes only when fts_rank is not null
candidate_membership_rule.vector: closeness contributes only when vec_rank is not null and vec_metric is native cosine_distance

feature_definition.decision_feature: max over the fixed top five candidates of eligible FTS coverage or eligible native-cosine closeness

manual_semantic_audit.finding: No E6 logical ID, query, record text, canary, temporal scenario, or expected result is copied from E0. Broad product nouns alone are not shared evaluation cases.
manual_semantic_audit.hybrid_paraphrase_rule: Every fit and held-out hybrid answerable case is marked semantic_paraphrase=true and required_lexical_overlap=false; reproduction proves its relevant row is absent from the complete FTS candidate set.
manual_semantic_audit.method: Human comparison of all E6 queries/records against every frozen E0 query and record.
